data.name: DX Legends
data.detailed_description:
You grab a pot, smash it into a rival and zip across the stage with your grapple to carry the princess to safety before your enemies do, while your boomerang loops back to finish them off. DX Legends is a top-down arena brawler in pixel art where every fight is fast, physical and chaotic, and everything you step on is a weapon. Draw your sword, drop bombs, chain combos and abilities: there are countless ways to send a rival sprawling. Play online with crossplay, throw a local party or jump into co-op with friends.

Game Modes

  • Save the Princess: grab the princess and carry her to safety before your rivals do.

  • Team & Free-for-All Deathmatch: fight in teams or everyone against everyone.

  • Crownball: chaotic ball mode, think Rocket League with brawlers.

  • Survival & Co-op Survival: hold out against endless waves of enemies.

Features

  • Physical combat: grab, throw, smash. The stage is your arsenal.

  • Four modes built on the same quick, easy-to-learn combat.

  • Character editor: create, share and download Legends.

  • Play how you like: online with crossplay (PC, Mac and Linux), local parties up to 12, or co-op with friends.

Build Your Legend

  • Design your own character in the in-game editor.

  • Share your creations and download Legends made by other players.
